// SDT Extraction
(Raw representation avoided to prevent serialization errors. Core variables added to DataDictionary.)

dataDictionary.name: Proximity
dataDictionary.description: Proximity of the beacon from the device. The value in this property gives a general sense of the relative distance to the beacon.

dataDictionary.name: Distance
dataDictionary.description: The estimated proximity value, measured in meters from the beacon. This value is heavily subject to variations in an RF environment. A negative accuracy value indicates the proximity is unknown.

dataDictionary.name: Signal
dataDictionary.description: Received signal strength in decibels of the specified beacon. This value is an average of the RSSI samples collected since this beacon was last reported.
